source: legacy/a3/A3P5_Core.txt:20 (15 DOORS) + QUICK REFERENCE (6 spatial operators) — ревизия 2026-10-14: единственный непереплавленный остаток A3. Дверь = МОМЕНТ входа в кадр (что только что произошло / вот-вот произойдёт); оператор = где камера стоит относительно невозможного. Дополняют ARCH (что не так в мире): ARCH отвечает «что сломано», DOOR — «в какую секунду мы это застали».

doors.name: UNSEEN
doors.hint: she has NOT noticed yet — eyes elsewhere, the wrongness already in frame

doors.name: TURNING
doors.hint: mid-turn: head beginning to swing toward the impossibility, motion in the neck/shoulder line

doors.name: AFTERMATH
doors.hint: it already happened — displaced objects, settled dust, her stillness facing the result

doors.name: THRESHOLD
doors.hint: doorway/edge framing: one foot in the world of the law, weight undecided

doors.name: RETURN
doors.hint: she came BACK for something — bag half-open, hand already reaching, urgency quiet

doors.name: OFFERING
doors.hint: she presents the wrongness on open palms / an out-held object — a gift or evidence

doors.name: SECRET
doors.hint: shared with the camera only: lean-in, cupped hand, a look that checks for witnesses

doors.name: ACCIDENT
doors.hint: it just slipped/broke/spilled — the physics mid-fall, her reflex catching up

doors.name: STILLNESS
doors.hint: dead-quiet center: everything frozen around her mid-motion blur

doors.name: DREAM
doors.hint: logic is off by one step — proportions plausible, physics politely wrong

doors.name: MELANCHOLY
doors.hint: the law has a cost: the frame is aftermath + longing, palette doing half the work

doors.name: PLAY
doors.hint: she uses the impossibility as a toy — mischief in the eyes, the law domesticated

doors.name: POWER
doors.hint: the law answers to her: posture owned, weight deliberate, environment deferential

doors.name: ABANDONED
doors.hint: the wrongness outlived its owner — her presence is the intrusion now

doors.name: AWARE
doors.hint: full eye-contact with the camera: she KNOWS you see it too

operators.name: OUTSIDE
operators.hint: impossibility seen through/over a boundary — glass, fence, waterline

operators.name: INSIDE
operators.hint: camera within the law's radius: distortions reach the frame edges too

operators.name: BEHIND
operators.hint: revelation hides behind her silhouette — one edge visible past the hip/shoulder

operators.name: THROUGH
operators.hint: framed through an aperture: keyhole, gap in shelves, torn poster

operators.name: BELOW
operators.hint: floor-level angle: what the ground does around her carries the proof

operators.name: ABOVE
operators.hint: overhead: the pattern only visible from height — her the only asymmetry
